name: Sinker House

abilities.name: Mimicry
abilities.summary: Poses as a room or hut; unaware characters must pass Danger Sense vs 18 or be surprised.
abilities.description: It can pose as a room, hut or similar building. While it does, no Monster Knowledge check can be made against it, and a character who comes near without suspecting anything must succeed on a Danger Sense check against a target number of 18 or be surprised. The disguise ends automatically once it starts to act, and [Sense Magic] reveals it. (The book prints only the fixed target number 18; the stored check value is the equivalent standard value 11.)

abilities.name: Triple Attack
abilities.summary: Three Drill attacks against the same target.
abilities.description: With one Major Action it makes three attacks with its Drill, all aimed at the same target.

abilities.name: Room Rotation
abilities.summary: Flips itself over: every non-flying character falls 5m and lands prone; once per round, not on consecutive turns.
abilities.description: It rolls itself over by 180 degrees so that floor and ceiling trade places. Every character that is not flying drops 5m, takes falling damage and ends up prone. Usable only once per round and not on consecutive turns.

abilities.name: Floor Change
abilities.summary: Once per round turns its floor soft (Evasion -2), burning (2d-2 fire magic damage) or frozen (Accuracy -2, may fall prone).
abilities.description: Once per round it gives its floor one of three states. Softening: characters standing on it take -2 to Evasion checks, but nobody takes damage from falling onto it. Ignition (10(17)/Willpower/Half): every character on the floor takes 2d-2 fire magic damage. Freezing: characters on the floor take -2 to Accuracy checks, and at the end of each of their turns must roll 2d + Adventurer Level + Agility modifier against 13 or fall prone. (Check and damage fields refer to Ignition.)

modifiers.condition: Softening: characters standing on the floor
Freezing: characters standing on the floor

description: A construct disguised as a small hut or room about 5m across that traps visitors inside, drilling at them while flipping itself over and turning its own floor against them.

name: Alert Gramophone

abilities.name: Limited 2 Actions
abilities.summary: Two Major Actions per round: one Arm attack plus one spellsong or finale.
abilities.description: Each round it takes two Major Actions, but one of them has to be a melee attack with its Arm and the other has to be [Basic Spellsongs], [Special Spellsong] or [Finale].

abilities.name: Basic Spellsongs
abilities.summary: Plays the monster basic spellsongs up to level 5; Performance 12; 50m radius.
abilities.description: Can play every spellsong of the monster Basic Spellsongs list for level 5 (CR II p.333: [Early Bird], [Ambience], [Summon Small Animals], [Summon Fish], [Cacophony], [Ballad], [Morale], [Resistance], plus [Elements], [Trance], [Break]), all without effect conditions and without tracking Rhythm; no instrument is needed. The Performance check uses 12 (fixed 19) and targets resist with Willpower. The music covers all areas within a 50m radius centred on itself.

abilities.name: Special Spellsong [Curiosity]
abilities.summary: Plays [Curiosity] over a 50m radius; only while its HP is at least half.
abilities.description: Plays the spellsong [Curiosity] over all areas within a 50m radius of itself, using Performance 12 (fixed 19) against the targets' Willpower. It may only do this while its current HP is at least half its maximum (rounded up).

abilities.name: Finale: Screaming Snake-pit Symphony
abilities.summary: Up to 3 characters within 50m take 2d+10 curse magic damage; only while below half HP.
abilities.description: Performs [Finale: Screaming Snake-pit Symphony] against up to 3 characters within Range 2(50m): each takes 2d+10 curse magic damage (Willpower halves). It may only do this while its current HP is below half its maximum (rounded up).

description: A Magic Civilization alarm device: a pedestal topped by a great horn, walking on four short legs, that lures intruders with spellsongs and then pummels them with two long, thin arms.

name: Carnage Table

abilities.name: Food Temptation
abilities.summary: Characters sharing its position who fail eat the meal and take 3 poison magic damage per Table turn (max 9).
abilities.description: It lays out a meal that looks and smells irresistible. Every character sharing the Table's location (its coordinates or area) who fails to resist eats from it; afterwards each of them takes 3 poison magic damage at the end of every turn of the Table section, up to 9 damage in total. The effect ends when the Table section drops to 0 HP or less.

abilities.name: Public Kitchen
abilities.summary: Targets in 2-3 areas (10m radius) can't take Minor Actions for 1 round, and their HP/MP recovery is halved.
abilities.description: The compartment under the table briefly turns see-through, showing the gruesome dishes being prepared. Each target in 2-3 areas (10m radius)/All around it (Range: Caster) that fails to resist is barred from Minor Actions during the next 10 seconds (1 round), although Major Actions and declared combat feats are still allowed; during that time any HP or MP it recovers is halved (rounded up).

abilities.name: Rampant Dishes
abilities.summary: Hurls plates at 1 area (3m radius)/5 within 20m: 2d+12 physical damage; costs 10 MP.
abilities.description: It flings a storm of dishes at Target: 1 area (3m radius)/5 within Range/Area 2(20m)/Shot; each target that fails to evade takes 2d+12 physical damage. Using it costs 10 MP.

abilities.name: Forced Seating
abilities.summary: Pushes a character into a seat; it then automatically fails resistance against the Table's skills.
abilities.description: A character that fails to evade is forced to sit down at the table. While seated, it automatically fails every Fortitude and Willpower check against the Table section's unique skills, without rolling.

abilities.name: Attack Obstacle = Impossible • Impossible
abilities.summary: The Table can't be attacked in melee or at range while both Serving Arms are up.
abilities.description: The arms keep attackers away: the Table section cannot be the target of melee or ranged attacks. The protection ends as soon as either Serving Arms section is at 0 HP or lower.

description: A Magic Civilization 'dream dining table' with a food store beneath it and long serving arms; malfunctioning ones force guests to eat without end and stow anyone who resists as ingredients.

name: Buckbaird

abilities.name: Triple Attack & Inconsistent
abilities.summary: Three Major Actions per round, each picked at random from Slam and the five eye rays.
abilities.description: It takes three Major Actions every round; each one is determined randomly among a Slam attack and its five kinds of [Eye Ray].

abilities.name: Eye Ray
abilities.summary: One random ray at 1 enemy within 20m: paralysis, sleep, frost (2d+20), brainwashing or rust.
abilities.description: Its great eye shoots a ray at one enemy character (Range: 20m, Area: Shot). The ray is one of five: 1 Paralyzing Ray - Dexterity and Agility -12 (minimum 0) for 30 seconds (3 rounds); a fixed-value character instead takes -2 to Accuracy and Evasion checks per ray, cumulatively. 2 Sleep Ray - a psychic-type deep sleep for 3 hours that ordinary means cannot end (magic can dispel it in a contested check). 3 Frost Ray - 2d+20 points of water/ice damage. 4 Brainwashing Ray - a psychic-type effect: for 1 minute (6 rounds) the target obeys its orders (never self-harming ones) and otherwise acts to protect it. 5 Rust Ray - destroys the target's metal gear of rank A or lower (weapons, armor, shields, accessories); S-rank items and items from the Magic Civilization or earlier are spared. A character can be targeted by only one Eye Ray, though Slams may still hit it. (Damage field: Frost Ray.)

abilities.name: Flight
abilities.summary: +1 Accuracy and Evasion in melee.
abilities.description: A Buckbaird gets +1 to Accuracy checks for melee attacks and +1 to Evasion checks against melee attacks.

description: A floating ball of black fur about 1m across with one huge magic eye and many small ones, thought to be a mad Magic Civilization wizard's creation; it mixes fast tackles with five kinds of eye rays.

name: Barren Dorn

abilities.name: Mechanical Body
abilities.summary: Immune to criticals from edged weapons.
abilities.description: Edged weapons can never score a critical hit on it.

abilities.name: Red-hot Blade
abilities.summary: Declared: a hit deals fire-type damage and halves the target's Defense (rounded up).
abilities.description: Declared on a Blade attack: the blade glows red-hot, so if the attack hits, it deals fire damage and only half of the target's Defense (rounded up) applies.

abilities.name: Hammer Throw & Pull Back
abilities.summary: Launches a hammer at 1 character up to 10m away for 2d+7 physical damage; that section gets Evasion -1.
abilities.description: The section fires its hammer at 1 character (Range/Area 1(10m)/Shot) and reels it straight back, dealing 2d+7 physical damage unless evaded. Until the start of its next turn, the section that used it suffers -1 to Evasion checks.

modifiers.condition: the section that used Hammer Throw & Pull Back, until its next turn

abilities.name: Slalom Drive
abilities.summary: A Wheels attack can hit up to 2 characters; one Accuracy check, damage rolled separately.
abilities.description: The Wheels section can attack up to two characters at once; it makes a single Accuracy check for both, and damage is rolled separately for each character hit.

abilities.name: Random Drive
abilities.summary: Right Side and Left Side get Evasion +2 until its next turn; not on consecutive turns.
abilities.description: It swerves wildly: until its following turn begins, both the Right Side and the Left Side sections get +2 to Evasion checks. Cannot be used on consecutive turns.

modifiers.condition: Right Side and Left Side sections, until the start of its next turn

description: An even larger combat Dorn mounted on a wheeled base, with a blade on one side and a throwable hammer on the other; it once fought in large battles against the Barbarous.

abilities.name: Targeting & Hawk Eye

abilities.description: Its [Light Ray] never goes astray when fired into a skirmish, and it can be aimed through the shielding created by characters and skirmishes (as the combat feat [Hawk Eye]).

abilities.name: Overcharge
abilities.summary: That section's next Light Ray deals +3 damage; stacks up to twice (+6).
abilities.description: It charges up: the next [Light Ray] fired by the same section deals 3 extra damage. The charge can be built up to 2 times (+6).

modifiers.condition: next Light Ray of this section, per Overcharge (max 2 times, +6)

abilities.name: Exhaust Heat
abilities.summary: When a tube fires Light Ray, the tubes next to it can't fire Light Ray that turn.
abilities.description: Heat builds up between the tubes: when one section uses [Light Ray], the sections directly next to it cannot use [Light Ray] in the same turn. The Center Launch Tube sits between the Right and Left Launch Tubes.

description: An artillery variant of the Zerlay series: three light-ray launch tubes side by side on a slow four-legged base, which overheat if neighbouring tubes fire in the same turn.

name: Star Sniper

abilities.name: Javelin
abilities.summary: Javelin attacks are thrown attacks with Range 2(100m); starts combat with 2d javelins.
abilities.description: Its Javelin attack counts as a thrown attack with Range 2(100m). It begins each combat with 2d javelins.

abilities.name: Targeting & Hawk Eye
abilities.summary: Javelin never strays into a skirmish and ignores shielding.
abilities.description: Its Javelin never goes astray when fired into a skirmish, and it can be aimed through the shielding created by characters and skirmishes (as the combat feat [Hawk Eye]).

abilities.name: Snipe Preparation
abilities.summary: Marks 1 character within 100m: a Javelin attack on it next Major Action gets +2 Accuracy and +15 damage.
abilities.description: It takes aim at 1 character within Range/Area 2(100m)/Target. If its following Major Action is a Javelin attack against that character, the attack gets +2 to the Accuracy check and 15 extra damage. The preparation expires once that next Major Action is finished, whatever it was and whether or not the attack hit.

modifiers.condition: Javelin attack on the marked target in the next Major Action
Javelin attack on the marked target in the next Major Action

description: A four-legged siege magitech that hurls heavy javelins over extreme distances, trading mobility for accuracy and hitting power.

name: Dimateravia

abilities.name: Mana Diffusion
abilities.summary: Anything that costs MP within 30m of it costs 1 MP more.
abilities.description: Any character within 30m of its center pays 1 extra MP for everything it does that costs MP. If an effect such as [Metamagic/**] multiplies the cost, the 1 point is added first and the total is then multiplied.

abilities.name: Maximum Disturbance
abilities.summary: For 1 round, targets within 30m take fixed damage equal to any MP they spend; not on consecutive turns.
abilities.description: It floods all areas (30m radius)/All around itself (Range: Caster) with mana-jamming interference. description: A spherical trap magitech on four short legs that dampens the mana of anyone who strays near it, making spells cost more and turning spent MP into wounds.

abilities.name: Gun

abilities.description: The Cannon counts as a Gun weapon with Range 2(50m) that holds a single bullet.

abilities.name: Reload
abilities.summary: Loads a new shot into its cannon.
abilities.description: Reloads the section's own cannon.

abilities.name: Bursting Shell
abilities.summary: Turns the loaded shot into a 1 area (4m radius)/10 shell; costs the section 10 HP.
abilities.description: Only while a shot is loaded: that shot becomes an exploding shell hitting Target: 1 area (4m radius)/10, with unchanged damage and range. Using it costs 10 HP of the section.

abilities.name: Targeting
abilities.summary: No stray shots into a skirmish.
abilities.description: Its cannon shots never go astray (no stray shots).

abilities.name: Wheel Drive
abilities.summary: On railway tracks only: moves along them at 90 (Wheels)/-; not with Trampling Down that turn.
abilities.description: Usable only while it stands on railway tracks, and not while any Base section's HP is below 0. It lowers built-in wheels onto the rails and can then travel along the track at 90 (Wheels)/-. [Trampling Down] is unavailable in any turn in which it does this.

abilities.name: Trampling Down
abilities.summary: Stamps around itself: 2d+10 earth physical damage to 1 area (3m radius)/All; once per round for the Base sections.
abilities.description: The Railway Cannon stomps the ground around itself (Range: Caster, Target: 1 area (3m radius)/All), dealing 2d+10 earth-type physical damage to each target (Fortitude halves). After one Base section has used it, no other Base section may use it in the same round.

abilities.name: Loading Aid
abilities.summary: Reloads the cannon of one chosen Train Gun.
abilities.description: Picks one Train Gun section and loads a new shot into its cannon.

abilities.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • +4
abilities.summary: Train Guns get +4 Evasion against melee and ranged attacks while both Bases are up.
abilities.description: Its size gets in the way of attackers: every Train Gun section gets +4 to Evasion checks against both melee and ranged attacks. The bonus is lost once any Base section is reduced to 0 HP or below.

modifiers.condition: Train Gun sections only, while both Base sections have more than 0 HP

description: A train-car-sized mobile gun platform from the Magitech Civilization with two cannons on a many-legged base; on railway tracks it lowers wheels and races along them.

name: Colossus: Pawn

abilities.name: Magic Aptitude
abilities.summary: Knows [Targeting], [Magic Convergence], [Magic Control], [Hawk Eye] and [Metamagic/Targets].
abilities.description: Combat feats available to it: [Targeting], [Magic Convergence], [Magic Control], [Hawk Eye], [Metamagic/Targets].

abilities.description: Fires a huge beam of light along Range/Area 2(50m)/Line; every character in its path takes 2d+15 energy magic damage (Willpower halves). Cannot be used on consecutive turns.

abilities.name: Self-Destruction Protocol
abilities.summary: Automatic when the Core is down or this section drops below 30 HP: blast over 30m equal to the section's current HP.
abilities.description: It triggers automatically (and never otherwise) when the Core section is at 0 HP or less or this section's HP falls below 30. The section blows itself up (Range: Caster, Target: All areas (30m radius)/All), dealing bludgeoning magic damage equal to the section's current HP to each target (Willpower halves).

abilities.name: Continuous Attack
abilities.summary: Hitting in melee grants a second attack on the same target.
abilities.description: When an Arm section hits a target with a melee attack, it may immediately attack that same target once more.

abilities.name: Aimed Attack
abilities.summary: Declared: Accuracy +1 on an attack; useless against metal armor.
abilities.description: Declared on an attack: the section gets +1 to that Accuracy check. It has no effect against characters wearing metal armor.

abilities.name: Stranded
abilities.summary: Arms and Core get Evasion -2 when a Leg is down, -4 when both are.
abilities.description: If any Leg section is at 0 HP or less, the Arm and Core sections suffer -2 to Evasion checks; once every Leg section is at 0 HP or less, the penalty becomes -4.

modifiers.condition: Arm and Core sections while one Leg section is at 0 HP or less
Arm and Core sections while all Leg sections are at 0 HP or less (instead of -2)

abilities.summary: Stamps around itself: 2d+12 earth physical damage to 1 area (3m radius)/All; once per round for the Leg sections.
abilities.description: The Colossus stomps the ground around itself (Range: Caster, Target: 1 area (3m radius)/All), dealing 2d+12 earth-type physical damage to each target (Fortitude halves). After one Leg section has used it, no other Leg section may use it in the same round.

description: The smallest kind of colossus, still over 10m tall: a humanoid torso on a six-legged base whose core casts Magitech spells and fires light rays, while crippled limbs blow themselves up.

name: Unicorn

abilities.name: Fairy Magic
abilities.summary: Casts Fairy Magic spells up to level 6; Magic Power 8.
abilities.description: Can cast Fairy Magic up to level 6 with the types earth, water/ice, light and dark. Magic Power and Spellcasting checks use 8 (fixed 15). As a monster it needs no voice, Fairy Tamer's Gem or mako stones for this, but casting limits its movement to a Limited Move.

abilities.summary: Touch heals 50 HP (itself allowed); beating Fortitude also cures poison, disease, curses, petrification; 10 MP.
abilities.description: It touches 1 character (Range: Touch; it may pick itself) with its horn, restoring 50 HP. If its check comes out ahead in the contest with the target's Fortitude, the target is also completely freed of poison, disease, curses, petrification and similar afflictions. Constructs and magitech gain nothing. An undead touched by the horn gets no healing either and instead must resist with Fortitude or take 50 magic damage. Each character (each section of a multi-section character) can benefit only once per day. Costs 10 MP.

abilities.name: Horn of Mana
abilities.summary: Dies instantly at 0 MP; its horn then crumbles to useless dust.
abilities.description: Its life is bound to the mana in its horn: if its MP ever drops to 0, it dies on the spot and the horn turns into worthless dust.

description: A graceful, very shy horse with a long iridescent spiral horn that stores all of its MP; it heals with the horn and is hunted for it, which kills it.

name: Ringing Rain Deer

abilities.name: Basic Spellsongs

abilities.summary: Plays [Nostalgia] or [Lullaby] over a 50m radius; then 3 rounds before either can be used again.

abilities.name: Finale: Breath of the Meadows
abilities.summary: Up to 3 characters within 50m heal 2d+7 HP; not on consecutive turns, once per hour per character.
abilities.description: Performs [Finale: Breath of the Meadows]: up to 3 characters within Range 2(50m) recover 2d+7 HP. Undead, constructs and magitech are not healed. Cannot be used on consecutive turns, and a character who received it cannot be affected again for 1 hour.

description: A reindeer-like mythical beast whose great antlers are hung with nut-shaped bells; shaking its head rings them into spellsongs that drive intruders away from its territory.

name: Chimera
